prompt.zh-TW: 北岸印刷今年營業收入 {{money:vars.revenue}}，年底機器設備淨額 {{money:vars.machinery}}。依課程 Excel 口徑（用期末餘額）計算{{term:tm_4tz4q9pa|plain}}，以「次」作答。
prompt.en: Northshore Printing had revenue of {{money:vars.revenue}} this year and machinery and equipment (net) of {{money:vars.machinery}} at year end. Using the course Excel basis (closing balance), what is the {{term:tm_4tz4q9pa|plain}}? Answer in times.

explanation.zh-TW: {{term:tm_4tz4q9pa}}＝{{term:tm_v3n8q2ye}} ÷ {{term:tm_gt8g4afe}}（淨額），回答「每一元的設備一年做出多少營收」。課程 Excel 用期末淨額，年報用平均淨額。如果年底才大量添購印刷機，分母一下子變大、營收還沒跟上，比率會先往下掉，所以判讀時要問設備是什麼時候買的。
explanation.en: {{term:tm_4tz4q9pa}} = {{term:tm_v3n8q2ye}} ÷ {{term:tm_gt8g4afe}} (net): how much revenue each dollar of equipment brings in over a year. The course Excel uses the closing net balance; annual reports use the average. If a batch of presses is bought just before year end, the denominator jumps before revenue catches up and the ratio dips, so ask when the equipment was bought.
